identifier.value: Siglo Prepaid Home Wireless Internet Service

product.name: Siglo Prepaid Home Wireless Internet Service
product.description: A prepaid wireless internet service offering unlimited data with download and upload speeds up to 100 Mbps for residential users in urban communities.

product.name: Siglo Installation and Equipment Provision
product.description: Installation service includes setup of wireless antenna and Wi-Fi modem at the customer's residence, with the modem becoming customer property after payment.

product.name: Siglo Payment and Recharge Options
product.description: Multiple payment methods for prepaid internet service including cash, bank transfers, credit/debit cards, and mobile payments through SigloPay.

product.name: Siglo Referral and Loyalty Program
product.description: A program that rewards customers with credit points for referring new users and for timely and continuous payments, which can be used to pay for service.
